title: Individual
subtitle: 本課涵蓋三個主要義項：
description: 本課涵蓋三個主要義項：

words.note: 最直接、最自然地表示一個人。
words.example: Each person must complete the form separately.
words.exampleZh: 每個人都必須分別填寫表格。

exercises.original: Each individual must complete the form separately.
exercises.zh: 每個人都必須分別填寫表格。
exercises.upgrade: Each person must complete the form separately.

options.explanation: 只有在已知這些人屬於某群體時才自然。
最直接、最自然表示一個人。
作名詞可用，但日常此處不如 person 自然。

exercises.original: The policy affects every individual differently.
exercises.zh: 這項政策對每個人的影響不同。
exercises.upgrade: The policy affects every person differently.

options.explanation: 一般談每個人時最自然。

exercises.original: The service is available to any individual over eighteen.
exercises.zh: 這項服務供任何十八歲以上人士使用。
exercises.upgrade: The service is available to any person over eighteen.

options.explanation: 行政／資格語境中也很自然。
any 後通常用單數 person。

words.note: 正式或強調「作為一個人」時可代替 individual。

exercises.original: Every individual deserves to be treated with dignity.
exercises.zh: 每個人都應受到有尊嚴的對待。
exercises.upgrade: Every human being deserves to be treated with dignity.

options.explanation: 強調「作為人」的普遍尊嚴，很合適。
指全人類／人性，不是單一個體。

exercises.original: No individual can live entirely without social contact.
exercises.zh: 沒有人可以完全沒有社交接觸地生活。
exercises.upgrade: No human being can live entirely without social contact.

options.explanation: 談普遍人類狀況時自然。

exercises.original: Each individual has basic physical and emotional needs.
exercises.zh: 每個人都有基本身體和情感需要。
exercises.upgrade: Each human being has basic physical and emotional needs.

options.explanation: 強調普遍人的基本需要。
表示重要人物／角色，語義不同。

words.note: 強調只是「一個人」，而不是一群人。
words.example: No single person can solve the problem alone.
words.exampleZh: 沒有任何一個人能單獨解決這個問題。

exercises.original: No individual could complete the entire project alone.
exercises.zh: 沒有任何一個人能單獨完成整個項目。
exercises.upgrade: No single person could complete the entire project alone.

options.explanation: 可以是一名成員，但沒有突出數量一。

exercises.original: One individual cannot represent the views of the whole community.
exercises.zh: 單一個人不能代表整個社群的觀點。
exercises.upgrade: One single person cannot represent the views of the whole community.

options.explanation: 語義可理解，但沒有突出 one。
如果指社群成員也可，但不如 single person 明確。
表示被挑出的某人，意思不同。

exercises.original: The decision should not depend on one individual.
exercises.zh: 這個決定不應取決於單一個人。
exercises.upgrade: The decision should not depend on a single person.

options.explanation: 重點是決策權不能集中在一個人身上。

words.note: 當 individual 指某個組織、團隊或群體中的一員時可接近。
words.example: Each member of the team has a different role.
words.exampleZh: 團隊中的每位成員都有不同角色。

exercises.original: Each individual on the committee has one vote.
exercises.zh: 委員會每位成員都有一票。
exercises.upgrade: Each member of the committee has one vote.

exercises.original: Every individual in the team is responsible for one task.
exercises.zh: 團隊每位成員都負責一項工作。
exercises.upgrade: Every member of the team is responsible for one task.

exercises.original: The club contacted each individual separately.
exercises.zh: 俱樂部分別聯絡每位成員。
exercises.upgrade: The club contacted each member separately.

options.explanation: member 不一定正在參與某活動。

words.note: 當形容詞 individual 強調「每一個分開看」時很接近。
words.example: Each single item was checked carefully.
words.exampleZh: 每一件物品都經過仔細檢查。

exercises.original: Each individual item was checked before shipment.
exercises.zh: 每一件單獨物品在出貨前都經過檢查。
exercises.upgrade: Each single item was checked before shipment.

options.explanation: 也可，但更強調彼此分開，而不是「每一件」。
particular item 是某一特定物件，不等於每一件。

exercises.original: Every individual seat has a charging point.
exercises.zh: 每一個座位都有充電插座。
exercises.upgrade: Every single seat has a charging point.

options.explanation: every single 是常見強調結構。
也可表示每個分開，但語氣不同。
雖可表示單數／異常，這裡不自然。

exercises.original: The machine examines each individual component.
exercises.zh: 機器檢查每一個單一零件。
exercises.upgrade: The machine examines each single component.

options.explanation: 每個零件單獨檢查，最自然。
變成只檢查一個特定零件。

words.note: 表示不同單位彼此分開處理。
words.example: The documents were stored in separate folders.
words.exampleZh: 文件存放在不同的獨立資料夾中。

exercises.original: Each individual document is stored in its own folder.
exercises.zh: 每份文件都存放在獨立資料夾中。
exercises.upgrade: Each separate document is stored in its own folder.

options.explanation: its own folder 突出彼此分開。
也可，但不如 separate 強調分離存放。

exercises.original: The project is divided into individual sections.
exercises.zh: 項目被分成多個獨立部分。
exercises.upgrade: The project is divided into separate sections.

options.explanation: 被分割成彼此獨立部分，是最自然。

exercises.original: Each individual account is managed independently.
exercises.zh: 每個帳戶都分開管理。
exercises.upgrade: Each separate account is managed independently.

options.explanation: 可能表示私人帳戶，但不是「分開」。

words.note: 表示某一個特定的人、物或情況。
words.example: This rule applies to one particular group.
words.exampleZh: 這條規則適用於某一個特定群體。

exercises.original: The rule applies to one individual case.
exercises.zh: 這條規則適用於某一個特定個案。
exercises.upgrade: The rule applies to one particular case.

options.explanation: 表示與個人有關，不一定是特定案件。
one ... case 強調某個指定個案。

exercises.original: We are interested in this individual problem rather than the whole system.
exercises.zh: 我們關注的是這個特定問題，而不是整個系統。
exercises.upgrade: We are interested in this particular problem rather than the whole system.

options.explanation: this ... rather than the whole system 強調某一具體問題。

exercises.original: The data relates to one individual region.
exercises.zh: 數據與某一個特定地區有關。
exercises.upgrade: The data relates to one particular region.

options.explanation: 指定某個 region，非常自然。

words.note: 表示和某一個人、其想法、情況、資料或偏好有關。
words.example: The decision depends on personal circumstances.
words.exampleZh: 這個決定取決於個人情況。

exercises.original: The decision depends on individual circumstances.
exercises.zh: 這個決定取決於個人情況。
exercises.upgrade: The decision depends on personal circumstances.

options.explanation: 表示特定，但少了「屬於某人的」意思。

exercises.original: Employees can discuss individual concerns with their manager.
exercises.zh: 員工可以和經理討論個人憂慮。
exercises.upgrade: Employees can discuss personal concerns with their manager.

options.explanation: 和個人自身情況有關，最自然。

exercises.original: The form asks for individual details such as address and phone number.
exercises.zh: 表格要求填寫地址和電話等個人資料。
exercises.upgrade: The form asks for personal details such as address and phone number.

options.explanation: 不表示屬於某人的資料。

words.note: 表示內容、服務或安排按照某個人的需要調整。
words.exampleZh: 這個應用程式提供個人化推薦。

exercises.original: The service gives individual recommendations based on each user's needs.
exercises.zh: 服務根據每位使用者需要提供個人化推薦。
exercises.upgrade: The service gives personalized recommendations based on each user's needs.

options.explanation: 只是特定推薦，不表示按使用者需求調整。
based on each user's needs 是最直接線索。
personal 可表示個人的，但不如 personalized 強調訂製。

exercises.original: Students receive individual feedback on their writing.
exercises.zh: 學生會收到針對自己寫作的個人化回饋。
exercises.upgrade: Students receive personalized feedback on their writing.

options.explanation: 回饋針對每名學生的作品調整。
可表示分開提供，但不保證內容有訂製。
不自然形容 feedback 作此義。

exercises.original: The website creates an individual learning plan for each user.
exercises.zh: 網站為每位使用者建立個人化學習計劃。
exercises.upgrade: The website creates a personalized learning plan for each user.

options.explanation: 也可表示個人的，但 personalized 更強調按需要設計。
for each user + customized plan 最自然。
不一定每個計劃完全獨一無二。

words.note: 表示一名服務提供者與一名使用者之間的個別安排。
words.exampleZh: 學生可獲得一對一支援。

exercises.original: Students can receive individual support from a tutor.
exercises.zh: 學生可以獲得導師一對一支援。
exercises.upgrade: Students can receive one-to-one support from a tutor.

options.explanation: 可表示個人支援，但不一定是一名導師對一名學生。
私下不等於一對一教學。
表示逐個進行，不一定是一對一支援。

exercises.original: The program includes individual coaching sessions.
exercises.zh: 計劃包括一對一教練指導課節。
exercises.upgrade: The program includes one-to-one coaching sessions.

options.explanation: 內容可以個人化，但 session 形式未必只有兩人。
教練與一名學員直接互動，最精確。
表示一個人獨自，不是兩人互動。
作名詞時有時可用，但此處需要形容詞。

exercises.original: Each employee has an individual meeting with their manager once a month.
exercises.zh: 每位員工每月和經理進行一次一對一會議。
exercises.upgrade: Each employee has a one-to-one meeting with their manager once a month.

options.explanation: 可表示和個人情況有關，但不一定只有兩人。
employee + manager 是明確兩人會議。
錯誤，會變成只有一個人參加。

falseSynonyms.zh: 私人的 ≠ 個別的 private 強調非公開或私人所有，不等於 individual。
獨特的 ≠ 個別的 unique 表示獨一無二，不只是「單一」。
獨立的 ≠ 個別的 independent 表示不依賴他人，不等於 separate individual item。
具體／特定 ≠ 所有 individual specific 可以接近 particular，但不一定表示一個人或一個單位。
獨自 ≠ 個別 alone 表示沒有其他人在一起，不是形容詞 individual 的一般替代詞。
個性 ≠ 個人 personality 是性格特質，不是 person。
詞形陷阱 - individual = 個人；個別的 - individually = 個別地 - individuality = 個性；個體性
詞形不同 - person = 人 - personal = 個人的 - personally = 就個人而言／親自
